# D-nat expansion data card (generated by analysis/p3_data_card_ext.py)

Source `EleutherAI/hendrycks_math@21a5633873b6a120296cce3e2df9d5550074f4a3`, split test, 5000 rows. Kept 4497 items (4485 canonical IDs, 12 merges of near-duplicates within the expansion); dropped 503 already in the pool (dev 100, test 403; by match: exact_normalized 500, minhash 3; matched source: math500 55, prm800k_sc 448). Gold = last `\boxed{}` of the solution; agreement with MATH-500's answer field 1.000 on 500 overlapping problems.
